caveats: Repairs the 12 days of 2024 where a truncating cast on a float32-denormalised doy loaded the previous day's IONEX map. Unaffected days must reproduce to ~1e-5 TECU; that agreement is the regression check.

Must stay on the pre-rebuild script, permanently: this stage is the regression check for the GIM day-lookup repair, and porting it into stec/ would mean the check and the thing it checks share an implementation.
description: recompute the IGS GIM baseline against the correct day's IONEX map
